summary: {coordinator} locates a qualified reader when a resident asks to use one.
realLife: Merced agreed to identify qualified readers and interpreters and to put time frames for filling requests into written procedures.
gates: A resident requests assistance reading materials for a county service.
inGame: needs: the requested support, scheduled service and provider's availability.

turns.what: Staff confirm the appointment with the resident.
turns.pulledBy: A qualified reader accepts the assignment.
turns.writesBack: The request has a named provider and time.

turns.what: The coordinator asks the resident about another available time.
turns.writesBack: The appointment remains open pending the resident's reply.
